summary: Completed Higher Secondary Certificate in Science from Notre Dame College, Dhaka (Batch '19, Group 13) with GPA 4.67 / 5.00 under the Dhaka Education Board, covering the standard science curriculum and actively participating in club activities.

formativeMilestones.title: Pope Francis Apostolic Visit & Protocol Volunteer Force
formativeMilestones.description: Handpicked by Father Susanto among a 20-member student volunteer team and subsequently selected into the elite 6-member core protocol force for Pope Francis’s 100,000-attendee Papal Mass at Ramna and 10,000-youth NDC campus gathering. Underwent multi-week training in international VIP and event security protocols.
formativeMilestones.impact: Cross-cultural leadership, international security protocol & institutional pride

formativeMilestones.title: Student-Led Road Safety & Civic Governance Movement
formativeMilestones.description: Participated in the historic, student-organized nationwide road safety movement across Dhaka, actively advocating for vehicle licensing compliance, emergency lane discipline, and civic accountability.

formativeMilestones.title: Noterdamian Traditions of Rigor & Punctuality
formativeMilestones.description: Immersed in Notre Dame College’s legendary institutional ethos—strict 8:10 AM gate punctuality, academic camaraderie across Ganguly and Harrington halls, and holistic character formation.
